finding: The saved router-first skeleton's direct Extension<Principal> extractor is not justified by rmcp's built-in Streamable HTTP path. At this release, the HTTP transport inserts http::request::Parts as one non-wire MCP request extension; RequestContext is then built from the request's Extensions. The generic Extension<T> extractor only looks up T directly in RequestContext.extensions. Therefore a Principal placed by trusted Tower/Axum authentication middleware in the HTTP request's parts.extensions is not automatically flattened into MCP Extensions as Principal. The source-qualified bridge is to obtain RequestContext<RoleServer> (or an extractor for the Parts object if Clone bounds permit), retrieve http::request::Parts from context.extensions, then read Principal from parts.extensions. This keeps client _meta untrusted and reuses the transport's trusted server-side HTTP metadata channel.
official_example_support: The exact-release counter server reads axum::http::request::Parts from RequestContext.extensions for Streamable HTTP headers, confirming this is the supported transport metadata shape.
scope_limits: This does not prove a particular authentication middleware implementation or identity format.
It does not make stock TaskManager persistent or create-or-get idempotent.
It does not solve restart redrive or exactly-once external effects.
The saved Rust skeleton remains NOT COMPILED in this environment.
candidate_revision: Replace Extension<Principal> in the task tool with RequestContext<RoleServer>-based extraction: get http::request::Parts from context.extensions, then get a server-authenticated Principal from parts.extensions. Fail closed if either is absent. Keep RequestStateCodec associated-data binding to that authenticated principal.
quota_zero_assessment: The principal bridge itself is in-process transport metadata handling and has no inherent hosted-runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package, cloud-credit, or external API/model quota dependency. Full Phase-1 acceptance remains false because durable store/redriver/effect-fencing obligations are unresolved.
tested_scope: Exact-source inspection only; no cargo/rustc compile or runtime authentication test performed.
